_comment: ds4 only runs its own GGUFs, so this list is short and follows https://dwarfstar.sh/hardware/.
resident_gib is ds4's own memory plan (`ds4: memory: ... planned`) at the launch context; measured is true when it was read from a real run.
recommended_ram_gib is [from, up to): the machine memory class this model is the suggestion for. min_ram_gib: the least memory it is worth offering on.
revision pins the Hugging Face repo commit the size and SHA-256 were read from.

models.name: DeepSeek V4 Flash (Q2)
models.description: ds4's baseline: fast, fully in memory.
models.origin: DeepSeek V4 Flash by DeepSeek (MIT), quantised by antirez for ds4

models.name: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (Q2)
models.description: Stronger and slower: streams its experts from the SSD, so it needs a fast local SSD.

models.name: DeepSeek V4 Flash (Q4)
